claims.statement: The production UI is a Next.js App Router/React/Tailwind static export deployed from out/ to GitHub Pages, with private responses and resume links excluded from generated public and offline assets.
React uses the repository-level store and cloud controller, while shared root domain modules remain active cross-runtime dependencies and the Playwright runner stays outside the frontend bundle.
Account synchronization serializes browser writes, retains unsynced local changes on failure, validates owned batch links, and falls back to public jobs when a private batch is unavailable.

The Supabase agent gateway is the privileged boundary that distinguishes human Supabase sessions from scoped opaque agent credentials and applies bounded parsing, database dispatch, revision checks, and short-lived resume signing.

The local runner forwards hosted data operations and adds only narrow form/resume/submission tools on one dedicated Playwright page, with per-call scope checks and no general browser or shell capability.
Network persists owner-scoped company workspaces separately from shared company identity, contacts, applications, and Circle revisions; its Circle view reads permitted current-membership sources.
